title: 7 Must-have No-code Tools to Build Your Next Business | Make

facts.fact: The page was published on July 7, 2022.
Make says its no-code tool recommendations were chosen by four criteria: user reviews (number and overall scores), features, level of difficulty or user-friendliness, and pricing.
facts.quote: User reviews (number and overall scores) Features Level of difficulty / user-friendliness Pricing

facts.fact: Make says Adalo's paid plans include publishing apps to the Google and Apple app stores, connecting apps to external data sources, and API access.
facts.quote: paid plans tackle important aspects like publishing to Google and Apple app stores, connecting your app to external data repositories, and API access

facts.fact: Make claims that Adalo lets businesses launch simple apps without spending tens of thousands of dollars on them.
facts.quote: without spending tens of thousands of dollars on it
